name: ro-everywhere-find
reason: With neither indexes/ nor the user cache directory writable, Python keeps the index in memory for the process and answers. nh reads indexes by path and keeps no per-process database (it would leave a temporary file behind or need exit-time cleanup), so after Python's two 'not writable' notes it exits 2 naming the problem instead of answering; it never returns a silent zero.
stderr:
building the full-text index for <ROOT> (one-time, after any corpus change)...
full-text: <ROOT>/indexes is not writable (unable to open database file); trying the next location
full-text: <CACHEDIR> is not writable ([Errno 13] Permission denied: '<CACHE>/niagara-help'); trying the next location
ERROR: full-text index indexes/fulltext.sqlite under <ROOT> is missing and cannot be built: neither indexes/ nor the user cache directory is writable
